name: Hollow Hold
research: Supine, pelvis flat (root rot X -90, pelvis joint 0.11 m) -> hip L (0.11, 0.003, 0.161). Upper trunk curled 4+6+7+7+5 = 29 deg (spine05 +4 = lumbar flattened, never arched) so the shoulder blades leave the floor. Legs straight and together, 10 deg off the floor: hip-ankle 0.905 (soft ~9 deg knee), dx -0.06, dy -0.888, dz +0.157 -> ankle (0.05,-0.885,0.318), heels ~0.25 m up; ankles 0.10 apart = feet touching; toes pointed (rot X -10 follows the leg line). Knee pole up (+Z). Arms by the ears: elev 170 / plane 90 in the torso frame (10 deg toward the ceiling from the spine line), elbows 5 -> with the ~15 deg torso tilt the arms sit ~25 deg above the floor. skin options copied from the approved overhead shoulder press (preserve volume, calm armpits). Sources S1 ACE hollow-body (low back pressed down, biceps by ears), S2 Oliva-Lozano 2020 (V-sit RA ~80%).
